300:t_2:48.en:
$n
「Feel better...? You're the one who was down, $$スズネ$$.」

300:t_2:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Lately... you've been helping me all the time.」

300:t_2:53.en:
$n
「Have I managed to repay you a little?」

300:t_2:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You finished repaying me long ago...」

300:t_2:56.en:
$n
「...I've been thinking all this time about what I can do with $$ジェニオン$$, after everyone has helped me so much...」

300:t_2:57.en:
$n
「My answer was to fight and grow stronger so I could protect someone, but...」

300:t_2:58.en:
$n
「Lately, I've begun to understand a little that what I lacked was strength in the truest sense.」

300:t_2:60.en:
$n
「I must do what I need to do, without clinging to convenient hopes or lashing out in despair...」

300:t_2:61.en:
$n
「When I can do that... I think I can grow even stronger.」

300:t_2:62.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Could you mean what happened at $$ラース・バビロン$$...?」

300:t_2:63.en:
$n
「At that moment... I felt as though I'd managed to overcome something, just a little.」

300:t_2:64.en:
$n
(If I can gain that strength, then surely, even Mom...)

300:t_2:66.en:
$n
「It's an encrypted communications code...! Someone from $c is contacting us!」

300:t_2:68.en:
$n
「Just as I thought, we weren't the only survivors!」

300:t_2:69.en:
$n
「We can't wait until morning. Let's go, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

300:t_2:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What should I do...? Even at a time like this... my heart won't stop pounding...)

300:t_2:72.en:
$$スズネ$$
(...I've made up my mind, $n... I'll follow you, whatever happens...)

300:t_2:73.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Even if the end of the world is approaching, I believe in the strength you're striving for.)

300:t_2:78.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「...Your wounds seem completely healed, $$キリコ$$.」

300:t_2:79.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Thanks for taking care of me, $$ポタリア$$.」

300:t_2:80.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「You sure surprised me, though. I thought you were just waiting to die, but in a week you were up and moving.」

300:t_2:82.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「You guys are much the same. You came fleeing into $$クメン$$ in tatters.」

300:t_2:83.en:
$$スザク$$
「Thank you, $$ポタリア$$ and $$キデーラ$$.」

300:t_2:84.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Without your protection, we would certainly have been wiped out.」

300:t_2:85.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Heh... It feels strange getting thanks from the great leader of the $$黒の騎士団$$.」

300:t_2:86.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「I'd heard about $c's exploits, but to think a $$時空震動$$ scattered you all...」

300:t_2:87.en:
$$カレン$$
「But we were lucky we got sent somewhere near $$クメン$$.」

300:t_2:89.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(This is too convenient to be a coincidence... It must be due to $$キリコ$$'s power as an $$異能生存体$$.)

300:t_2:90.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still, I never thought $$クメン$$ would still be resisting the Empire...」

300:t_2:91.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Even after the civil war, this country fought the old $$地球連邦$$'s annexation policy. Even our civilians are used to guerrilla warfare.」

300:t_2:92.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「It's strange coming from a mercenary like me, but these people are diehard resistance fighters.」

300:t_2:93.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So they're like $$新日本$$.」

300:t_2:94.en:
$$カレン$$
「And the spirit of $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$ is still alive.」

300:t_2:95.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「...It isn't just our strength that's allowed this country to keep resisting.」

300:t_2:97.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「It's not like they're working with us, but...」

300:t_2:98.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「They're the people from 《$$マーティアル$$》.」

300:t_2:100.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What's that bunch of combat nuts who say fighting makes humans evolve got to do with this?」

300:t_2:101.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Around the end of the civil war, members of $$マーティアル$$ began coming into $$クメン$$.」

300:t_2:102.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「There are many people from $$アストラギウス$$ here, so it didn't take long for their faith to spread.」

300:t_2:103.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Apparently they don't get along with $$サイデリアル$$, and they're fighting the Empire on their own.」

300:t_2:104.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...If we take advantage of that, we may be able to escape...」

300:t_2:106.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「We've finished emergency repairs on all our machines. The Empire is pursuing us. Staying too long would cause trouble for you, too.」

300:t_2:107.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「I guess you can't stay and fight alongside us...」

300:t_2:108.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm sorry, $$キデーラ$$... We have things we have to do.」

300:t_2:109.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Don't worry, $$カレン$$. Let's have another drink when things settle down.」

300:t_2:110.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$クメン$$ holds fond memories. When that happens, we'll have $$カレン$$ be our bunny girl.」

300:t_2:111.en:
$$カレン$$
「You... even at a time like this...!」

300:t_2:112.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, I'm looking forward to that!」

300:t_2:113.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're the same... even at a time like this...」

300:t_2:114.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Have you fallen for me all over again?」

300:t_2:115.en:
$$マオ$$
「...I do respect you. For never changing, anyway.」

300:t_2:116.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゼロ$$... What will you do once we leave here?」

300:t_2:117.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「First, we'll gather information. ...When that $$時空震動$$ hit, $$ヒイロ$$'s group and $n were near us.」

300:t_2:118.en:
$$スザク$$
「You think they were sent somewhere near Southeast Asia, too?」

300:t_2:119.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That's right. We'll try to meet up with them as we head for $$メリダ島$$, where $$ミスリル$$'s base is.」

300:t_2:120.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I've already been contacting them with secret communications codes, mixed with fake and dummy messages.」

300:t_2:122.en:
$$クルツ$$
「He was near us, too. I'm sure he got sent somewhere around here.」

300:t_2:124.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That black AS piloted by $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

300:t_2:125.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Its overwhelming combat power, enough to crush even the $$アーバレスト$$, far surpasses that of any AS we know.」

300:t_2:126.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That man even created a $$時空震動弾$$. His mind is truly both a marvel and a menace.」

300:t_2:127.en:
$$カレン$$
「And he took $$かなめ$$ away...」

300:t_2:128.en:
$$マオ$$
(So $$アマルガム$$ has finally gotten hold of $$カナメ$$... a $$ウィスパード$$...)

300:t_2:129.en:
$$クルツ$$
(With all that chaos... I'm not even sure $$テッサ$$ has received this information...)

300:t_2:130.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「...Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$, who's scouting ahead, has contacted us. $$サイデリアル$$ has moved its front west, leaving this area lightly defended.」
